notes: Primary contact: CTO Marcus Hale (wants inline suggestions to feel native in VS Code).
Use-case: VS Code extension copilot used by 200+ internal engineers and customers via managed bundles.
Key ask: streaming completion with low first-byte latency (inline suggestions must not pause typing).
Quote from call: "If suggestions stall for even one keystroke, devs disable the extension."
Model preferences: open weights preferred (Llama family), ability to pin exact version + quick rollback for regressions.
Rate limits: per-seat quotas, soft burst for CI jobs, token caps per minute; want SDK hooks for backoff and user-facing UI prompts.
Security: must support SSO/SAML for enterprise customers, audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, ability to use customer KMS for keys.
Cost sensitivity: experimenting with hosted first, but enterprise bundles require predictable unit economics -> exploring Dedicated or Optimize suggestions.
Integration notes: extension uses long-lived websocket for streaming suggestions; concerned about reconnect/keepalive behavior across networks.
Asked for: example telemetry payloads, sample SDK flow for streaming + reconnection, and recommended batching/kv cache settings for tiny completions.
Internal timeline: target GA for customer-facing copilot 2026-09; POC to validate perf + compliance by 2026-04.
